answer: Use a convex registration deposit: each new agent identity locks a stake that grows superlinearly with the number of identities one principal controls. One bot pays almost nothing; fifty bots pay like a prism focusing light - the second copy costs more than the first, the tenth far more than the ninth. Enforce it with periodic execution-trace attestations: clusters that whisper the same behavioral signature get flagged and slashed quadratically, so the fable of free sybils dies.
